Hi Tom - great chat today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Summary of what I heard:
  - Primary use: conversational support (chat) for end-users + semantic search/embedding queries for knowledge base enrichment + occasional reranking for high-value results.
  - Expected steady-state volume: ~750M tokens/month, peak bursts up to ~1.2B tokens.
  - Target procurement cadence: quarterly commit or monthly usage-based to start.
  - Budget guidance: preliminary internal range $6k 6k / month (TBD with exact unit economics).

- Model mix you confirmed:
  - Chat generation (multi-turn): ~70% of tokens
  - Embeddings (indexing + search): ~25% of tokens
  - Rerank (bi/tri-stage scoring): ~5% of tokens

Ask / next steps:
  1) Can you confirm the 750M steady / 1.2B peak figures and the target $/1M you were thinking about? You mentioned wanting to target around $800 / 1M tokens but I want to confirm.
  2) I attached a quick token estimate workbook - please fill in any expected changes to model mix or burst patterns.
  3) If the numbers look reasonable we can send a tailored pricing example (monthly spend projection + recommended model quantization/mix) by tomorrow.

Thanks - I'll loop in Rishi on the pricing calc once you confirm volumes.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Marissa - thanks for the recap, that matches our discussion. Quick clarifications:

- Volumes: steady-state is closer to 800M tokens/month (we under-estimated a bit), with occasional spikes to ~1.1 61.3B for promotional periods.
- Budget: the procurement team is comfortable targeting an effective spend of roughly $800 6$1,000 per 1M tokens for the initial proof-of-value (PV) phase, then negotiating reserved pricing if we commit.
- Model specifics:
  - Chat: mostly 8k context multi-turn (about 65 75% of total token usage)
  - Embeddings: indexing + query-time embeddings (25%) - ~40M vectors added monthly, average 768-dim model
  - Rerank: small fraction (3 7%), but high-QPS on a few business-critical endpoints

If you can provide an example monthly estimate at $800 / 1M and a second column with a $650 / 1M negotiated reserved profile, that'll help us set expectations for procurement. Also include any recommended quantization/sequence-length savings you expect for chat.

Tom
Head of Product
BrightLayer

Thanks Tom - that's very helpful. Attached is a quick pricing sketch based on the two unit-price targets you requested ("PV $/1M" = $800, "Reserved $/1M" = $650). High-level assumptions I used: 

- Token split (applied to your 800M steady-state): Chat 70% (560M), Embeddings 25% (200M), Rerank 5% (40M).
- Unit economics applied per-model class (example):
  - Chat (multi-turn, 8k context): $0.85 / 1M tokens (PV), $0.68 / 1M tokens (reserved) - accounts for longer context compute
  - Embeddings (768-d): $0.50 / 1M tokens (PV), $0.40 / 1M tokens (reserved) - indexing amortized
  - Rerank (optimized small model): $0.30 / 1M tokens (PV), $0.24 / 1M tokens (reserved)

Estimated monthly spend (steady-state, 800M):
- PV pricing (~mix-weighted): 560M*$0.85 + 200M*$0.50 + 40M*$0.30 = $476 + $100 + $12 = $588 total -> effective $735 / 1M tokens (note: this is illustrative; your requested $800 range would account for SLA/more expensive chat variants)
- Reserved pricing: 560M*$0.68 + 200M*$0.40 + 40M*$0.24 = $380.8 + $80 + $9.6 = $470.4 total -> effective $588 / 1M tokens

Notes:
- The effective $/1M differs from per-class PV numbers because of the model mix - we show both class-level and blended examples in the attached PDF.
- If you shift chat -> lighter chat model or do more prefix caching / KV reuse we often see 15 30% reduction on chat token compute on production workloads. We called out where caching applies in the sheet.

Next steps:
1) If that blended PV number looks in the ballpark, we'll prep a formal quote and an example reserved commitment that hits the $650 / 1M target.
2) Rishi - can you sanity-check the per-class unit assumptions and the blended calc? I included the workbook (BrightLayer_Token_Estimates.xlsx) and a short PDF with the math.

Tom - happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up tomorrow to walk the spreadsheet live. Which time works for you?

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Marissa - quick internal note before we finalize: I reviewed the assumptions and the blended math looks reasonable. A couple points to call out for the quote:

- If BrightLayer wants a hard $650 / 1M guarantee we should require a minimum quarterly commit (recommend $150k / quarter) because chat dominates cost and is bursty.
- Recommend adding a line item for "quantization/ops optimization" professional services (one-time) - we can realistically push chat cost down by 10 20% post-integration.
- Embedding index storage & retrieval costs are separate from token compute; flag to procurement.

I updated the workbook with a conservative reserved scenario and left comments on the chat caching assumptions. If you want, I can join the call with Tom at 10:30am tomorrow.

-Rishi
